newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chiyoda Corp falls on downward forecast.
newsitem.headline: Chiyoda Corp falls on downward forecast.

text.p: Shares of Chiyoda Corp dropped sharply in the afternoon on Monday, discouraged by a downward revision of its earnings forecast announced on Friday, traders said.
The share price of the plant engineering company shed 90 yen to 1,080 at 0447 GMT, the second sharpest percentage loss on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Turnover was 918,000 shares.
Chiyoda Corp on Friday forecast a parent current loss of 17 billion yen for the business year to March 31, 1997, against a previous forecast of a 1.5 billion yen profit.
